contents.name: §1, equations (1)–(4): edge-qubit stabilizers and commuting toric Hamiltonian

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete §1 construction and Hamiltonian passage in the full PDF, including the vertex and face products, their even-overlap commutation, and the penalty Hamiltonian.
source_review.supports: The square-torus Pauli and stabilizer conventions used in the local definition.
source_review.limitations: The local definition states its own finite-cellulation incidence convention and proves the needed algebraic identities from that convention; no physical realization or perturbation claim is imported.

contents.name: §1: global stabilizer constraints and toric ground-space dimension

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete square-torus constraint-count and ground-space discussion, including the two product relations and the four-dimensional torus case; separately verified the general genus count in the local proof.
source_review.supports: The use of global vertex and face constraints and the topology-dependent ground-space dimension.
source_review.limitations: Kitaev's displayed calculation is specialized to the square torus; the genus-g formula and weighted spectral bound are proved locally from the cellular chain ranks and the exact surface Euler supplier.

contents.name: §1: primal loops, dual cuts, and the homology description of logical operators

source_review.read_extent: Read the full loop/cut and homology passage, including the distinction between contractible stabilizer products and noncontractible operators.
source_review.supports: The primal/dual homology conventions for the finite square torus.
source_review.limitations: The exact disk-supported centralizer conclusion is derived locally by finite chain/cochain linear algebra and is not attributed as a source theorem.

contents.name: §1: primal and dual string commutation and local-error discussion

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete cited loop/cut discussion and its stated local-error scope in §1.
source_review.supports: The mod-two crossing convention and the separation between local stabilizer action and noncontractible logical strings.
source_review.limitations: The local proof establishes scalar compression for the stated disk/complement hypotheses and does not infer stability under arbitrary perturbations.
